data.body: CLI-tier completion remediation implemented in commit 2b20c7bb8b: the advertised/fetch-failed and reachable-absent force-new-store controls now invoke python -m rebar init --force-new-store as subprocesses. The advertised test uses a PATH-scoped Git shim that delegates the real ls-remote and all non-fetch operations, failing only fetch; it asserts nonzero, no tracker, no orphan, and actionable diagnostics. The absent test uses real Git end to end and asserts successful bootstrap plus warning. Evidence: affected integration file 12 passed in 3.69s; lint PASS; typecheck PASS; full suite 8510 passed, 31 skipped, 175 deselected in 29m57s.
